sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "attendance"."link_to_event" AS e, "event"."location" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "attendance" JOIN "event" ON "event"."event_id" = "attendance"."link_to_event"  GROUP BY "attendance"."link_to_event", "event"."location"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of attendance records (all level)
rank within the group by number of attendance records: share of the all total, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "expense"."link_to_budget" AS e, "budget"."event_status" AS g, SUM("expense"."cost") AS m1 FROM "expense" JOIN "budget" ON "budget"."budget_id" = "expense"."link_to_budget"  GROUP BY "expense"."link_to_budget", "budget"."event_status"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of expense cost per budget within budget.event_status (additive)
gap to the all average of total of expense cost (all level)
rank within the group by total of expense cost: gap to the all average, keep the top 3
